model: PowerXL DG1 / DH1 drives (on-board Modbus RTU / TCP)
applies_to: PowerXL DG1 general-purpose and DH1 HVAC drives per PowerXL Series VFD Communication Manual MN040010EN (June 2018).
summary: The PowerXL DG1 and DH1 are Eaton variable frequency drives with on-board RS-485 (Modbus RTU, BACnet MS/TP) and Ethernet (Modbus TCP, EtherNet/IP, BACnet IP). Both expose the same Modbus layout: monitoring values by ID, a fixed process-data block for control and status, and parameters by ID. This map covers the control and status words, speed reference, default process data and the main monitoring IDs.

addressing.note: The manual pairs each drive ID with a 4x register (ID 2001 = 42001, ID 1 = 40001) and its frame examples read 'holding registers 2000-2003' with start address 07D0h, so ID n goes on the wire as n-1 (40001 = address 0).

source.title: PowerXL Series VFD Communication Manual
source.pages: RTU settings p. 8; functions and frame examples pp. 10-11; register index and process data pp. 12-15; DH1 parameter list p. 205; process data defaults p. 222

notes: This copy is hosted by the US distributor Precision Electric; it is Eaton manual MN040010EN (June 2018).

Scales come from the 'Display format' column of the parameter ID lists (x100 = two decimals, x10 = one decimal, x0 = none) and from the Appendix B process-data table. INTEGER items are typed INT16 here (the process-data range is printed -32768...32767).

Process data out 8 is left out: the RTU chapter says it defaults to ID 28 (latest fault code) while Appendix B says FB Data Out 8 Sel defaults to ID 8 (unit temperature). Read ID 28 directly instead. Process data in 2-3 (setpoint/feedback) have no fixed unit and are left out.

Left out: every 4-byte (DOUBLE) value such as energy counters, PID setpoints/feedback and instant motor power, because the manual only says data is big endian and does not state the word order of 32-bit values; the FB general status word 2102, whose 'not used' bit marks did not survive in the table.
The DH1 menu codes are P12.3.x for RS-485 settings, the DG1 codes P20.3.x.

Left out: monitoring IDs whose unit the manual does not settle: analog inputs 1-2 and analog output 1 (IDs 10, 11, 25; the BACnet object table calls them volts), PT100 temperature (ID 27) and the PID1/PID2 outputs (IDs 22, 38).
RTU defaults from Table 8: slave address 1, baud rate code 1 (19200), parity code 2 (even, 1 stop bit). Data bits are not stated.

integration.summary: Write the control word at 2000 (bit 0 run, bit 1 reverse, bit 2 reset, bits 8-9 for fieldbus control and reference) and the speed reference at 2002, then read status 2100 and process data out 2103-2109.
integration.enable: Select Modbus RTU in RS485 comm set (DG1 P20.3.1.1 / DH1 P12.3.1.1, ID 586) and set slave address, baud rate and parity in the same group; set the control place and reference source to fieldbus.
integration.watchdog: DG1 has a Modbus RTU communication time-out (P20.3.2.9, ID 593, printed default 10000 ms); P20.3.2.10 / P12.3.2.6 (ID 2516) chooses whether a comm loss faults only in fieldbus control or in all control places.
quirks: Process data and IDs are Modicon-style: subtract 1 (and 40001) for the wire address.
Holding and input registers are the same data (function 03 or 04).
setup: Parity choice also sets stop bits: none = 2 stop bits, odd/even = 1 stop bit.
Defaults: 19200 baud, even parity, 1 stop bit.
gotchas: Control word bits 8 (FB control) and 9 (FB reference) must be set for the drive to take run and speed from the bus.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
note: Re-typed from the manufacturer's public documentation (see source) and verified against it. Registers vary by firmware and options; verify against the live device before writing.
